title: WikiContradict: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Real-World Knowledge Conflicts from Wikipedia

live_model.evidence: App. D: 'we tested ... Llama3-70b-instruct, and GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 ... temperature = 0, max_tokens = 250, seed = 5'; Table 3: 'GPT-4 86.7 76.1' (judge Acc / Macro-F)

prompt.location: Appendix C 'Further Details on the Judge LLM Prompt' (system prompt printed); Section 3 prompt templates 1-5 printed
prompt.note: judge labels a response correct / partially correct / incorrect against the answer list

claim.metric: judge accuracy vs human labels on prompt-template-5 responses
claim.location: Table 3, row GPT-4, column Acc (240 responses from five LLMs in WikiContradict_HumanEval)

data.source: WikiContradict (253 instances) and WikiContradict_HumanEval (1,200 human-judged samples), released on GitHub / HuggingFace

notes: Claim chosen is the meta-evaluation of GPT-4-turbo as judge (human labels are gold, no LLM judge needed). The main Table 2 numbers for GPT-4-turbo as a subject (e.g. 60.4% correct or partially correct under template 1, 48 instances) need human judging.
